speaker: narrator
text: Part eight. The city ate. And Bit went *dark*.

speaker: narrator
text: Morning. One sunbeam lands on Bit's *screen*.

speaker: bit
text: Power at one percent. Good *morning*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit! Don't you *ever* do that again!

speaker: narrator
text: The whole city is pink again. And *hungry*.

speaker: narrator
text: Rosa's Diner has a line around the *block*.

speaker: chef
text: Thirty years. My best Friday *ever*.

speaker: narrator
text: Rosa takes down the *for sale* sign.

speaker: hero
text: Rosa, let me pay you back. *Every* bowl.

speaker: chef
text: Then wash the dishes, Jay. Paid. *Full time*.

speaker: narrator
text: Mia orders the biggest pancakes on the *menu*.

speaker: friend
text: Sunlight is great. But it has no *syrup*.

speaker: bit
text: Fun fact. Some sea slugs drop their own *head*.

speaker: bit
text: The head regrows a whole body in *three weeks*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit. Do *not* put that in a smoothie.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay eats lunch at Rosa's every day. And *pays*.

speaker: narrator
text: But at noon, he still turns toward *the sun*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. Don't move. There's a *leaf* on your head.

speaker: hero
text: Bit. Was there algae in my *soup*?

speaker: narrator
text: Follow for a new What if every day.
